title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base: the SIGTERM exit leaves a temp tree behind
body: internal/cli/evacuate_signal_test.go:213 reports 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<n>]' — reproduced 3/3 at the base a999d400 in a scratch worktree before any of my commits, and 2/2 on my finished branch, so it is not vqc's (my change is SIGINT-only and does not touch the tempdir/evacuation path). It is an end-to-end test (skipped under -short), so `make gate` is green while `make test`/CI is red at base. The leftover name suggests the registry guard's temp root (learnings: 7ag, registrytest.GuardMain) is not being released on the SIGTERM exit path.
